entities.name: Most Dangerous Gamer
entities.description: A human guest of Myra's Astrotorium, the deadliest gamer in the galaxy, who wears a mask and sneaks in for the prizes.

entities.name: Myra the Magnificent
entities.description: Owner of the Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun who considers the gamer a plague of the park.

entities.name: Astrotorium
aliases: Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun
entities.description: A theme park, the gamer's favorite.

relations.note: She considers him the fifth plague of the park and curses his name.
relations.quote: Myra considers him to be the fifth plague of the park
